title: First Universaarl item controlled write gate
purpose: Create or cleanly block exactly one first Universaarl item after TARGET-040 proved the relevant item and inventory pages read-only.
entryCriteria: TARGET-040 observed Inventory Setup, Inventory Posting Setup, Item Posting Groups, Units of Measure and Items read-only in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
No setup, item, document, Preview Posting or Posting occurred in TARGET-040.
The next run must start with a fresh Smart Decision Card before clicking New on Items.
acceptanceCriteria: playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE is confirmed before any New action.
The Items list is captured before the write.
The New item route is captured with screenshot QA and dangerous dialogs are blocked.
At most one item is saved, or the route is blocked with a clear reason.
If saved, the item is reopened by list/card proof and the approved fields are visible.
No setup value, posting group, VAT group, document, Preview Posting, Posting or API shortcut is used.
Result JSON classifies the item as created, blocked, or partially completed with a narrow next step.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-040 proved five item/inventory Foundation pages read-only: Inventory Setup, Inventory Posting Setup, Item Posting Groups, Units of Measure and Items. It did not prove item creation or posting readiness.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: A first item is now the smallest useful next W1 Foundation record, but only if it avoids setup, posting group and document side effects.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Read-only item/inventory page context is available.
Run after the item write is created or blocked.
O2C still needs item, posting groups, VAT and expected entry trace boundaries.
Vendor remains blocked until a new non-repeated U-VEND Manual Nos. route exists.

queueChangesMade: Added TARGET-036E as the next narrow controlled first-item write gate.
nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It turns the read-only item/inventory preflight into one controlled master-data proof without jumping to setup, documents, Preview Posting or Posting.
risksBeforeNextCase: The New action can open template prompts.
Item cards can expose posting group defaults that are not yet approved.
Saving the wrong fields would create misleading book evidence.
requiredPreparation: Hover or screenshot the New route if ambiguity exists.
Stop on any template or setup dialog unless explicitly covered by the Smart Decision.
Use screenshot QA before and after saving or blocking.
